name: json-parse
algorithm: Parse a 1 MB JSON document (tools/bench gen kind json, seed 2) into each language's std tree type, reps times, and walk each tree (README.md).

skip.c: no std JSON: C has no standard JSON parser; no library stands in
skip.rust: no std JSON: Rust std has none (serde_json is a crate); no crate stands in
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the parse has no arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own algorithm; the checksum (values plus decoded string and key bytes) checks that every parser read the same tree
notes: Idiomatic standard library (plan/06-m6.md 4.1): Mk std.json.Parse (zero-copy strings, numbers as text) into an arena Reset per parse; Go encoding/json Decoder with UseNumber (numbers as text) into any; Zig std.json.parseFromSliceLeaky(std.json.Value) into an ArenaAllocator reset per parse. Bytes per second = 1000000 * reps / median.
